## Seeder class

Base class for every seeder.

**Signature:**

```typescript
export declare abstract class Seeder 
```

## Remarks

Seeders write through the portable [Seeder.insert()](./database.seeder.insert.md) helper rather than raw SQL, so the same seed data loads into Postgres, MySQL or sqlite unchanged.

Seeders are not tracked the way migrations are: running one twice runs it twice. Start with [Seeder.truncate()](./database.seeder.truncate.md) when a seeder needs to be repeatable.

`DatabaseSeeder` is the conventional entry point and composes the rest through [Seeder.call()](./database.seeder.call.md)<!-- -->.

## Example


```ts
import { Seeder } from '@monorepo-framework/database'

export default class UserSeeder extends Seeder {
  async run(): Promise<void> {
    await this.truncate('users')
    await this.insert('users', [
      { id: 1, name: 'Ada Lovelace', email: 'ada@example.com' },
    ])
  }
}
```
